description: This file defines the HospitalJobsScreen widget for a Flutter app, allowing users to view, add, and delete hospital job posts. It includes a static method for creating new job posts via a dialog, manages rendering of job list, and interacts with HospitalProvider for data operations.

classes.name: HospitalJobsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying a list of hospital job posts with functionality to add new jobs and delete existing ones.

methods.name: showCreateJobDialog
methods.description: A static asynchronous method that displays a dialog to input details for a new job post and creates the job via the HospitalProvider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the HospitalJobsScreen, showing instructions, a list of jobs, and delete buttons.
